name: Clean Math Generator
intent: A restrained, modern worksheet-generation surface that feels like a practical human-made tool rather than a generic AI dashboard.

witnesses.notes: Visual witness only. Preserve useful layout grammar and interaction clarity; do not copy branding, copy, proprietary assets, or distinctive implementation details.

layout.shape: single-purpose generator flowing from configuration toward output
layout.grouping: controls grouped by the decision they affect
layout.preview: worksheet/result is visually subordinate until generation

controls.treatment: conventional labeled inputs/selects with low-friction scanning

surface.cards: use grouping only when grouping carries meaning
surface.color: neutral base with one functional accent

typography.hierarchy: large page purpose, compact labels, readable result content

motion.rule: animation only when it explains state change

print.rule: generated worksheet is the artifact; controls disappear cleanly from print/PDF

avoid: large empty hero areas inside working tools
marketing copy mixed into the task flow
visual elements that do not encode state, hierarchy, or action
adaptation_rules: Preserve the fast generator feel while keeping Online School curriculum provenance visible when it materially helps the user.
Do not imitate NoteGPT branding, logos, wording, proprietary illustrations, or exact page composition.
Prefer conventional controls over novel controls when both express the same relation.
Keep editing and saved-library capabilities available without letting them dominate initial generation.
The worksheet preview must look like a printable educational artifact, not another dashboard card.
Knowledge-path and evidence features may add depth behind the surface without increasing visual noise.

review.notes: Approved as the first worksheet-generation visual witness.
